intro.text: A Shin Honorbearer who wields the Windrunner Honorblade and gathers acolytes expelled from other monasteries, training them as an army.

items.text: When Szeth was sent to kill him, Tuko said he had expected it since Szeth was first sent to train with the Honorblade. Before he died he warned Szeth that Pozen-son-Nash was using him like a "glassy-eyed sheep" and begged him to walk away from his orders. The Shin leaders afterwards admitted they had used Szeth to remove Tuko because he threatened their stability.
